name: Lucky Strike Casino
desc1: Decadance flows through the room like an over filled wine goblet. Fine
desc2: silk curtains cover the entrances north and west. You see card tables
desc3: made of cedar and silver scattered accross the room. Gathered around
desc4: are lucky winners and drunken losers, both looking for that next big
desc5: lucky streak, but only one seeming to find it and the other wishing
desc6: the day had never begun and drowning more in their sorrow and drink.
